summary_en.motivation: To develop a bioink with tunable mechanical properties for tissue engineering.

papers.title: Plasma electrolytic treatment of products after selective laser melting
papers.abstract: The aim of the work was to study the possibilities of plasma electrolytic treatment for cleaning surfaces of metal products obtained by the SLM-technology. We found that the most effective cleaning from the large alloy particles occurs in the "hydrodynamic" mode, when the occurrence of hydrodynamic pulses observed. Further smoothing of irregularities eliminated by a stable burning of discharge in vapor shell. Analysis the morphology of the surface of difficult specialized products, such as crown conical gears, after plasma hydrodynamic treatment showed efficiency and advantages in comparison to conventional methods of final cleaning such as shot blasting.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究等离子电解处理用于清洁SLM金属产品表面的可能性。
summary_zh.method: 采用“流体动力”模式进行等离子电解处理，并分析表面形貌。
summary_zh.result: 发现流体动力模式能有效清除大合金颗粒，稳定放电可进一步平滑表面。
summary_zh.validation: 通过复杂产品（如锥齿轮）的表面形貌分析验证处理效果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the feasibility of plasma electrolytic treatment for cleaning the surfaces of metal products fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Plasma electrolytic treatment was applied in a 'hydrodynamic' mode to remove large alloy particles, followed by stable discharge burning for surface smoothing.
summary_en.result: The hydrodynamic mode effectively removed large particles, and subsequent stable discharge further smoothed irregularities, showing advantages over conventional shot blasting.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through morphological analysis of complex products such as crown conical gears after treatment.
